svg.title: How to use the auth method readiness groups
svg.desc: The runbook keeps live Entra groups current. The telephony-only group is the migration list. Point a Conditional Access report-only policy at it, hand it to the service desk as a call list, and run a registration campaign at it, then watch it shrink each run until nobody depends on Microsoft-provided SMS or voice. The phishing-resistant and strong groups can be nested under a parent group that your own policy targets. The no-method, manual review and non-human exclusion groups are onboarded, triaged by hand, or kept out of user policies.
